short_description: Accelerators that are invisible to novices speed up expert interaction.

positive.definition: Common actions have keyboard shortcuts (cmd+s, cmd+k, cmd+/) and they are documented
positive.evidence_required: name the action and the shortcut

positive.definition: List views support multi-select and bulk operations
positive.evidence_required: name the list and the bulk affordance

positive.definition: User can customize the interface (rearrange, theme, save views)
Cmd+k command palette or quick switcher exists with discoverable entry
positive.evidence_required: name the affordance and how it opens

positive.definition: Frequent filter or query combinations can be saved and recalled

negative.definition: Common, repetitive actions have no keyboard shortcut
List operations require selecting and acting on each item individually with no bulk affordance
negative.evidence_required: name the list and the per-item action

negative.definition: Layout offers no customization where personalization would clearly help
negative.evidence_required: name the surface and what users would change

negative.definition: Common task takes 5+ clicks where 1-2 would suffice with a power-user shortcut
negative.evidence_required: name the task and count the clicks

critical_negative.definition: Critical surface is unusable without a pointer device (no keyboard fallback at all)
critical_negative.evidence_required: name the surface and the keyboard gap
